Hello!
It’s time for the last Weekly Update!
Wait… Last? Yes! That’s right!
Because… we’re preparing the release of the Early Access version of the game.
We will be announcing the release date soon.
We will also be presenting the mechanics slightly differently (e.g., we will show you all the locations available in Early Access and what makes them unique).
So - stay tuned, as we’ll be revealing more details soon! ːsteamhappyː
In the meantime, check out what we’ve added and improved in the project this week.
1. Stickers
We're adding stickers to the game. You'll be able to place them on your cars. We'll include various sticker designs, and you'll be able to buy them on UsedBay.
2. Hotwire
We're improving the car stealing. We've already shown you lockpicking before, but now we're adding hotwiring - you’ll need to know how to start the ignition too.
For that, you'll need a hotwire kit (which you'll have to get first) and a minigame that you’ll need to complete to successfully start the car.
After that, you “just” need to escape from the police. 😉

We're improving the inspection UI so you can see all the important details while checking a car - what model it is, which parts are missing, and its overall condition.

We’re adding more interactive objects that you will be able to discover in our game - now in Powerstation and Gas Station.

We're adding an option to switch between metric and imperial units, as well as between 24-hour and 12-hour time formats.

We're adding an indicator to show where the police are during a chase. You'll see it on the map, and while escaping, it will show which direction they're coming from.
7. UsedBay - Improvements
We're improving UsedBay. Now, when browsing car parts for sale, you'll see the text "You need this part!" next to any part your car is missing.
8. Bug Fixing & Optimization & Tests
We’re still working on testing, fixing bugs, and optimizing the game. 😉

items.text: 🚗 Hey Awesome Drivers!
NEW SIDE QUESTS
We’re adding two new types of side quests - giving you more ways to earn extra money and EXP.
The first type is all about package delivery. To start these quests, you’ll need to talk to the right NPCs, either at the port or at the supermarket.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/85695b875b7310142f6714bf21942bb28fcece0e.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/1cf691ab1a07c1d318838a6a8fa9853df67fd00c.png"]
You’ll also need specific vehicles for these jobs. Your task is simple: pick up the packages and deliver them to their recipients.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/924152f11522399b1ddd0b9ac81bfde3d35bfe37.png"]
The second type of side quest can be found by talking to random NPCs around the map.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/d9498ad6f770a9ab4ebdd4dbd1d81ece4fd9cd55.png"]
These quests are focused on finding various hidden items. You’ll need a metal detector and a shovel to complete them.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/803dd5511bfc708fc3a81d5e20fb6f314cf87cd9.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/e8d07e670d3538e823abadbc4d3eb6e238b725fe.png"]
POLICE IMPROVEMENTS
We’ve also made quite a few improvements to how the police system works, as many of you reported that it wasn’t always behaving as intended.
We’ve replaced the police car with… a helicopter. We’ve also improved how police chases work.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/537441d18c55bc71413bebb0aee5c6b5806c95e9.png"]
CARRYING ITEMS IN CERTAIN VEHICLES

As you may have already noticed with the new side quests, we’ve also added the ability to carry items in certain vehicles. We know some of you already tried doing this before ːsteamhappyː But it didn’t work properly back then. You can now transport items using the D-1CK, Burrito Bison, and Gravel Titan.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/eefea05809bd97fe607db0bb2bd44be69c4de128.png"]
a few optimization improvements
some translation improvements
And we're already working on the next update! ːsteamhappyː
P.S.

RALLY SHOP
We are adding a Rally Shop where you can upgrade your car.
You can find the new location on the map.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/6fb840533f997f694bca3d9ee64389d0de02b2ca.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/f553823e893277e1e6a11840a911403fd46eb30c.png"]
In the Rally Shop, you can upgrade your car's engine to increase its power.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/42ec611674ed428d6feb367531157ba6e91e0b6c.png"]
You can also install a roll cage, which helps protect the car in collisions and prevents the windows from shattering.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/5bb7337d6d3d557d518e635be4b4a7b7ca4398a6.png"]
Another option is to modify the suspension height and wheel spacing. In the Rally Shop, you can adjust their settings to whatever level you prefer.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/4afd452359628349c7cc1af7fde3844d7b158ac8.png"]

The Rally Shop is available from the start, and you can use it at any time. However, there is also a side quest that introduces you to the shop and rewards you with additional EXP and money upon completion.
You can begin this quest in several ways: by talking to the bartender, by speaking with the mechanic, or by going directly to the Rally Shop owner.

P.S. Completing the side quest is completely optional - the Rally Shop's services are available regardless of whether you take on the quest or not. The quest simply provides extra rewards and a guided introduction to the feature.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/f526029c52da5a0f048829fa53327c6c10dcf2b8.png"]
NEW RIMS
We’re adding 7 new types of rims. They can be purchased both at the Rally Shop and from the mechanic.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/f79699d6ee20f3091cc7085012f9c91519be67a2.png"]
NEW TIME ATTACKS
We've also added 10 new Time Attack tracks where you can put your upgraded cars to the test.
A good time to remind you of our roadmap - Rally Shop (and the other improvements) are the next step on the road to Season 3. We’re already preparing the next updates.

You’ll find them in side missions.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/1409b6561e264f199b2fc0941c6c07e635eac79b.png"]
You're supposed to go to the location you already know - the Port.
You’ll find a man there who sells cars through containers.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/234ab7fc265ca7402e34bd223e99eac8ce19be7d.png"]

We are refining the entire system for grabbing items, looking at them, and interacting with them. This also involves properly displaying the outline on specific objects. This will make it easier for you to navigate the game and understand specific tasks.

As we continue improving the terrain's appearance, we're moving on to the next regions. Here you can see our work on the surroundings of Lost Angeles - our lost city.

We're adding a lot of new mechanics, and we need to make sure that all of them save correctly and can be properly loaded. It's a very complex process - that's why we're working hard on it! ːsteamhappyː
6. Quests
We’re also continuing to develop the story of our game, adding new quests for you to complete.

We have also been working on adjusting the price of a car based on its condition. Let’s explain this with an example: a buyer proposed a price, but before the purchase, the car's condition significantly deteriorated (e.g., due to being hit with a baseball bat).

As a player, during the inspection, you will be able to see which parts are damaged. Consequently, the price of the car will change (you can also see this in the speech bubble above the seller's head).

It’s time for the next Weekly Update! As usual, in a few points, we'll present to you what we've been working on this week in Used Cars Simulator 😀
1. Refueling the Car

We are working on the fuel mechanics. Fuel will decrease while driving. You will receive two different notifications - that the fuel is running low and when it has completely run out. If you don't refuel in time, the car will stop.
When refueling, you will also see your money decrease (fuel costs, that's life ːsteamhappyː ).
2. Exiting the Car

We have spent a lot of time testing the car exit mechanics. We ensured that the player doesn't jump out or get stuck, for example, if you park too close to a wall. Here, you can see how we tested various options.
3. Scrap

We have been working on placing scrap in various locations on the map. It is one of the most valuable resources in the game - essential for repairing the car. You will be able to buy it at the scrapyard, but you can also find it yourself using a metal detector and a shovel.
4. Underwater Visuals

The game will take place on an island, so there will be plenty of access to water. We wanted to ensure that the underwater view looks good too (in case someone wants to test if their car can function as a submarine ːsteamhappyː ).
5. Skills - Categories
We are working hard on the Skill Tree. We are introducing skill categories that will allow the player to decide in which direction they want to develop their character.
6. 3D Car Plan

We have also started working on a 3D blueprint for car models. This will allow you to view different car parts more easily and check their condition. Each part will be properly highlighted. For now, we have begun creating the system for this blueprint - you can see how it looks in the initial stages.
7. NPC - details
